delegation.description: The wrapper classifies the user task and delegates to exactly one target AI-RULES.json.
delegation.fallback_question: Which area should be changed: frontend, backend, assets or generated code?
rules: Score each WRITE_AI_RULES_TO target with schema keywords and hooks.
Prefer explicit file paths over generic keywords.
Apply matching hooks, special routines and active weight table.
If no target is confident, ask fallback_question in AI_LANGUAGE.
If the task is only to define an operator role, do not delegate into implementation work.
When multiple targets score similarly, prefer explicit path evidence over keyword guesses.
Report low confidence instead of inventing a target.
